name: Pathros
overview: Pathros is presented in Scripture primarily as a region associated with Jewish captives dwelling in Egypt and subject to divine judgment. The prophet Jeremiah addresses the Jews living in Pathros, highlighting their idolatry and disobedience (Jeremiah 44:1,15). Ezekiel prophesies both the restoration of Egyptian captives to Pathros and the desolation of the land as part of God's righteous judgment (Ezekiel 29:14; 30:14). Isaiah further affirms that God will recover His people from Pathros among other nations, emphasizing His sovereign hand in the restoration of Israel (Isaiah 11:11).
